webhooks.detail: Webhooks created in UI (Settings > Integrations & dev > Webhooks), fired by triggers/macros; no subscribe API or event list found.

evidence.quote: Webhooks are user-defined HTTP callbacks that are triggered by specific events within Pylon.

sandbox.detail: No sandbox, test mode, or free developer account mentioned in API, webhooks, auth, rate-limit, SDK docs. Pricing page not checked.

evidence.quote: Receive webhooks for various events happening in Pylon.

rate_limits.summary: Per-org, per-endpoint per minute; tiers of 30, 120, or 300 req/min; 429 rate_limited on excess

evidence.quote: Pylon limits how many requests your organization can make to each API endpoint per minute.
